newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel April industrial exports up at $1.03 bln.
newsitem.headline: Israel April industrial exports up at $1.03 bln.

text.p: Israel's non-diamond industrial exports reached $1.03 billion in April, up 12.1 percent on a year earlier, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Wednesday.
In the first four months of 1997, industrial exports rose to $4.40 billion, up 9.5 percent on the same period in 1996.

Continuing trends begun in the second half of 1996, the ministry said export gains were led by communications equipment, medical and scientific equipment, chemicals and electronic components. Textile exports continued to decline.
